web.title: 18 Best Fintech Apps Built with Flutter
web.description:
Let's start with real-world examples that show how Flutter is already being used in fintech.

## Top 18 real fintech apps built with Flutter
### 1. Credit Agricole Bank Polska
Instead of iterating on an existing solution, the bank chose to build a brand-new app from scratch.

The result is CA24 Mobile, a modern banking app designed for retail customers, offering a seamless and consistent experience across platforms. With a large engineering team, this became one of the biggest Flutter implementations in fintech.

Check our [CA24 Mobile case study](https://leancode.co/case-studies/credit-agricole-bank-polska)!

### 4. Google Play
It allows users to pay online and in stores, manage expenses, and access financial services.

To improve efficiency, Google rebuilt Google Pay using Flutter.

### 5. Virgin Money

### 14. ProWallet
ProWallet is an instant payment solution designed for the construction industry, focused on digitalizing and unifying payment processes across the sector. The app aims to reduce costs, simplify workflows, and accelerate transactions by bringing all financial operations into a single digital system.

ProWallet enables users to load funds, send and request payments, and track all wallet activity with detailed transaction history and real-time notifications.

### 15. 3S Money
The mobile app, built with Flutter, focuses on delivering a secure and user-friendly experience for complex financial operations. Designed for business users, it supports features like multi-account management, currency exchange, and payment workflows, all within a streamlined interface optimized for everyday use.
